node.title: Re: Outputting input prompt with prove
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: You're right that [doc://prove] doesn't handle that situation very well (I tried [doc://ExtUtils::MakeMaker]'s prompt but that had the same issue), but then again, it's not really meant to, since tests should generally be able to run non-interactively. It sounds more like an [XY Problem] to me, could you explain what you need this for?
